name: CoreKeyboard
tagline: A simple virtual keyboard with word suggestions for x11 based systems
blurb: Working on touch devices is never easy unless you have a virtual keyboard application.
description: Working on touch devices is never easy unless you have a virtual keyboard application. CoreKeyboard is an X11 based virtual keyboard, one of the only two built using Qt (the other being kvkbd). Despite being built using Qt, CoreKeyboard works on all DEs, platforms and all text entry widgets. It also supports word suggestions.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
